name: Base values of channels added to a stack

provenance.author: UzmiGames
provenance.note: a channel added with add_channel starts from these values whatever its format, or only in the format an entry names; a channel type absent here, or added in another format than its entry names, fails evaluation explicitly (missing_base_value)

base_provenance.note: every texel stores 1.0 (code 65535 on L16): the base of an empty AO channel is white (exact)

Emissive added as sRGB8 and left empty exports 1.0 to OpenEXR 32f and 65535 to PNG 16 (sets s3 and s7, r1 and r2; decision 126); this default applies to sRGB8 only (L8: the next entry; other formats are not recorded and fail with missing_base_value)
Emissive added as L8 and left empty exports 1.0 to OpenEXR 32f and 255 and 65535 to PNG 8 and 16, RGB and L (set s3, r1 and r2; decision 204); this default applies to L8 only
float32(127/255), float32(127/255), 1.0 (height-to-normal.json, height-normal-default-normal-channel-base, exact): the 8-bit flat normal read as UNORM8

Specular added as sRGB8 and left empty exports float32(10/255) to OpenEXR 32f, linear, and its sRGB export encode to PNG 8 and 16 (sets s3 and s7, r1 and r2; decision 126); this default applies to sRGB8 only (L8: the next entry; other formats are not recorded and fail with missing_base_value)

Specular added as L8 and left empty exports float32(10/255) to OpenEXR 32f, linear, and (56, 10, 56) and (14330, 2570, 14330) to RGB PNG 8 and 16, the sRGB export encode in R and B and the linear write in G (set s3, r1 and r2; decision 204); this default applies to L8 only
Scattering (alias SubsurfaceRadiusScale) added as L32F exports 1.0 (OpenEXR 32f)
